author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: I am willing to accept a reduced scope of documentation for the heatwave model update. We can cut the detailed test case narratives for the standard seasonal articles. In exchange, the core compliance checks and privacy validation steps must remain fully intact and executed. If we drop those specific controls, I will refuse to sign off on the deployment. The documentation window is short, so I am trading the breadth of the manual review for the speed of the core validation. This allows us to move the weather feature forward without compromising the data governance standards we have agreed upon.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept reduced documentation scope (giving up breadth) in exchange for speed, while maintaining core controls.
